biography.value:
Tempered Alatreon (MHW)

Gargantuan dragon (elder), unaligned — Challenge 30

An Elder Dragon that cycles through fire, dragon, and ice states. Place the token, set the opening cycle with Active State, and use sheet features. State changes, horn tracking, Elemental Overload, Element Burst, Escaton Judgement, and blight applications run from the Amellwind module script.

Combat notes

  • Hunters Quantity: set 1–6 before the fight. Amellwind solo-boss HP (3 max / 4 +50% / 5 ×2) plus ×2.5 at 6. State threshold (~100/820) and horn HP (~200/820) scale with max HP. Overload soft curve: 15 / 17 / 19 / 20 (cap).
  • Active State: starts Fire (or Ice via Start Ice Cycle). Advance after the scaled state HP threshold is lost; Element Burst as a special reaction. Set Fire / Ice / Dragon State jumps manually and resets the threshold. Token light follows the state (fire orange, ice blue, dragon violet).
  • Horns: Deploy Horn Tokens (AC 30, base 200 HP each at 820 boss HP, 15 ft elevation). Breaking a horn reverts the previous state and cuts Escaton by 10d6. Apply Horn Damage remains as a manual fallback.
  • Elemental Overload: 1 charge per soft-scaled elemental chunk (15→20 by hunters; max 60). Tracked on the token's second bar and on the Elemental Overload feature uses; reduces Escaton dice.
  • Escaton Judgement: Charge then Release anytime from the sheet (suggested once during the second dragon state). 60d6 force, reduced by horns and charges; force immunity→resistance, resistance→normal, else vulnerability. Module chat is GM-whisper only.
  • Legendary Limit: each legendary option once per round. Mythic options are suggested by Active State (advisory notes on the AE / state chat; not blocked).
biography.public: A tempered Elder Dragon that cycles through fire, dragon, and ice states.

description.value:
Scale Tempered Alatreon for the hunting party before combat. Uses Amellwind solo-boss HP rules, plus a toolbox extension for 6 hunters:

  • 1–3 hunters: max HP (820) — Amellwind "maximize" baseline
  • 4 hunters: max HP + 50% (1230)
  • 5 hunters: max HP × 2 (1640)
  • 6 hunters: max HP × 2.5 (2050)

Active State threshold and horn HP scale as fractions of boss max HP (100 / 820 and 200 / 820). Elemental Overload uses a soft curve: 15 (1–3) / 17 (4) / 19 (5) / 20 (6; cap).

Run one of the Set N Hunters activities once after placing the token. Current HP and unbroken horns scale proportionally; the state HP-lost counter resets.
description.chat: Apply Amellwind party HP scaling (1–5) + ×2.5 at 6. State threshold and horns scale with max HP; overload uses soft 15→20 curve.

macro.name: Hunters Quantity

description.value:
The alatreon has three states: fire, dragon, and ice.

  • Fire State: immune to fire; vulnerable to cold. Token light turns orange-red.
  • Dragon State: resistant to all damage except necrotic, poison, and psychic. Token light turns violet.
  • Ice State: immune to cold; vulnerable to fire. Token light turns blue.

It begins combat in fire or ice. Fire cycle order: fire → dragon → ice → dragon (repeat). Ice cycle order: ice → dragon → fire → dragon (repeat).

Whenever hit points are reduced by the Active State threshold in the current active state (base 100 HP at 820 max; scales with Hunters Quantity), it advances to the next state and uses Element Burst as a special reaction (even if it already used its reaction).

Use Start Fire Cycle / Start Ice Cycle for the opening order. Use Set Fire / Ice / Dragon State to jump manually (resets the state HP threshold; keeps the current cycle and resyncs Escaton readiness). Use Hunters Quantity before the fight to scale HP and thresholds.
description.chat: Mythic active state (fire / dragon / ice). Advance after the state HP threshold is lost; Element Burst special reaction. Manual Set State resets the threshold. Threshold scales with Hunters Quantity.

effects.name: Fire State

effects.name: Dragon State

macro.name: Active State (Mythic Trait)

description.value:
The alatreon gains 1 charge for every chunk of elemental damage (fire, cold, or lightning) it takes from a single attack or spell. The chunk size follows a soft Hunters Quantity curve (not 1:1 with boss HP): 15 (1–3 hunters), 17 (4), 19 (5), 20 (6; cap). Charges reduce Escaton Judgement by 1d6 each (max 60, which zeroes Escaton from overload alone). Charges reset to 0 after Escaton Judgement.

Tracked on this feature's uses, on the token's second bar, and in system.resources.overload / flags.world.alatreon.overloadCharges.
description.chat: 1 charge per soft-scaled elemental chunk (15→17→19→20 by hunters; max 60 charges). Shown on this feature and the token bar. Resets after Escaton Judgement.

description.value:
The alatreon has two horns that can be attacked and broken separately:

  • AC 30; base 200 hit points each at 820 boss HP (~200/820 of max). Scales with Hunters Quantity.
  • Resistant to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing that do not deal siege damage.
  • Immune to poison, psychic, and the damage immunity from its current active state.
  • Deployed horn tokens sit at 15 ft elevation (harder for grounded melee).

Damage to a horn does not damage the alatreon. When a horn is broken, the alatreon reverts to its previous active state and Escaton Judgement loses 10d6.

Use Deploy Horn Tokens to place both horns on the VTT (Foundry icon icons/creatures/mammals/ox-bull-horned-glowing-orange.webp). Attack those tokens, or use Apply Horn Damage as a manual fallback. Apply Hunters Quantity before deploying if the party is not 3 hunters. Deploy persists horn actor/token ids on the boss in flags.world.alatreon.hornRefs.
description.chat: Two horns: AC 30, HP scales with Hunters Quantity (base 200 at 820 boss HP), 15 ft elevation. Breaking a horn reverts the previous active state and weakens Escaton.

description.value:
Recharge 5–6. Roll a d4 to determine the element: 1 fire, 2 cold, 3 necrotic, 4 lightning. The alatreon exhales that element in a 120-foot line that is 10 feet wide. Each creature in the line must make a DC 27 Dexterity saving throw, taking 63 (18d6) damage of the rolled type on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.

Placeholder damage type is fire; the engine rolls d4 and replaces the damage type.

macro.name: Elemental Breath

description.value:
Suggested timing: once during the second dragon state each time the active-state order repeats (the module still tracks readiness for GM whispers, but Charge/Release can be used anytime from the sheet).

Charge (action): The alatreon swoops down (no opportunity attacks) if airborne and gathers energy until the start of its next turn. While charging it is immune to incapacitated, stunned, paralyzed, and unconscious.

Release (action, next turn): Energy erupts in a 600-foot-radius sphere. Terrain above ground level in the area is obliterated. Each creature must make a DC 30 Dexterity saving throw, taking 210 (60d6) force damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success.

Against this damage, force traits are inverted: immunity becomes resistance, resistance becomes normal damage, and creatures with neither are vulnerable.

Reduce damage by 10d6 per broken horn, and by an additional #d6 equal to Elemental Overload charges.

Release is a Midi save activity (player owners roll). The module sets dice from horns/overload and applies force-trait inversion after the save. Automation chat is whispered to GMs only.
description.chat: Charge, then Release anytime from the sheet: 600-ft sphere, DC 30 Dex, 60d6 force (reduced by horns and overload; force traits invert).

effects.name: Escaton Judgement — Charging
effects.description: Gathering energy. Immune to incapacitated, stunned, paralyzed, and unconscious.

macro.name: Escaton Judgement

description.value:
When the alatreon changes active states, it can use this special reaction to release elemental energy. Each creature in a 30-foot-radius sphere must make a DC 27 Dexterity saving throw, taking 24 (7d6) damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success.

Damage type matches the new state: fire (fire), necrotic (dragon), cold (ice).

Auto-fires on state change via Midi completeActivityUse with engine-selected targets in 30 ft; type is set by the engine. Player owners roll the Dex save.
description.chat: Special reaction on state change: 30-ft sphere, DC 27 Dex, 7d6 (type by new state).

description.value:
Legendary Action. The alatreon fires five water globules at different points within a 150-foot cone. Each creature within 5 feet of a point must make a DC 27 Dexterity saving throw or take 14 (4d6) acid damage and be afflicted with waterblight for 1 minute (half damage and no blight on a success). A creature in more than one globule's area makes the save at disadvantage but takes no extra damage. Repeat Con save at end of turn to end waterblight.

Template is a 150-ft cone for placement; engine applies waterblight on failed saves.
description.chat: Legendary: 150-ft cone (5-ft globules), DC 27 Dex, 4d6 acid + waterblight.

Legendary Action. Lightning strikes from a space within 120 feet along a 45-foot line (5 feet wide), then a second 45-foot line that begins in or passes through a 5-foot space of the first. Each creature in a line must make a DC 27 Dexterity saving throw or take 22 (5d8) lightning damage and be afflicted with thunderblight for 1 minute (half damage and no blight on a success). Creatures in more than one line save at disadvantage with no extra damage.

Place the primary line; engine applies thunderblight on fail.

description.value:
Legendary Action (suggested in Fire State). The alatreon exhales fire in a 45-foot line (5 feet wide) that splits into two more 30-foot lines forming a "Y". Each creature in a line must make a DC 27 Dexterity saving throw, taking 35 (10d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success.

Primary line is the template; fork placement may be assisted by the engine.
description.chat: Legendary (fire): Y-shaped lines, DC 27 Dex, 10d6 fire.

macro.name: Fire Breath Y

description.value:
Legendary Action (suggested in Fire State). The alatreon rises 30 feet (no OA) and exhales flames covering the ground in a 30-foot radius centered on a point directly below it. The ground burns until the start of its next turn. Creatures that start their turn in the area or enter it take 10 (3d6) fire and ignite (2d6 fire at start of their turns until doused). Moving through the area deals 7 (2d6) fire per 5 feet.

Places a burning-ground template (engine).
description.chat: Legendary (fire): 30-ft burning ground until start of next turn.

macro.name: Scorched Earth

description.value:
Legendary Action (suggested in Ice State). The alatreon rises 30 feet (no OA) and exhales frost covering the ground in a 30-foot radius below it until the start of its next turn. Each creature that starts its turn there must make a DC 27 Constitution saving throw or take 17 (5d6) cold damage and iceblight for 1 minute (half damage and no blight on a success). Moving through the area deals 7 (2d6) cold per 5 feet.

Places an ice-zone template. Start-of-turn ticks use the Frost Zone — Start of Turn save activity (Midi / player owners). Movement cold stays module-scripted.
description.chat: Legendary (ice): 30-ft frost zone, DC 27 Con, 5d6 cold + iceblight.

effects.name: Iceblight
effects.description: Speed halved. Restricted reactions/attacks per iceblight rules. DC 27 Con at end of turn to end.

macro.name: Frost Breath

description.value:
Legendary Action (suggested in Ice State). Ice shards form above each creature in a 90-foot radius and plummet. Each creature must make a DC 27 Dexterity saving throw, taking 13 (3d8) cold plus 18 (4d8) bludgeoning damage, being pushed 5 feet, and knocked prone on a fail (half damage, pushed, not prone on a success). Ice-chunk tokens remain on the canvas until the start of the alatreon's next turn (AC 10; 10 HP; vulnerable to fire; immune to cold, poison, psychic). If an ice shard takes necrotic damage, it explodes in a 15-ft radius for 1d8 piercing.

Engine spawns Ice Shard tokens for creatures in the area, applies prone on fail, melts tokens on Alatreon's next turn, and auto-explodes on necrotic.
description.chat: Legendary (ice): 90-ft radius, DC 27 Dex, 3d8 cold + 4d8 bludgeoning, prone on fail; ice-chunk tokens on canvas.

macro.name: Ice Shards
